conbody.p: If the ROE is not linked to a period of employment or if the ROE is linked to a period of employment without a corresponding electronic ROD or ADJ WI, the officer must complete the Resolve Issue section of the ROE RFS Action WI before completing the WI. When resolving the issue, the officer must review the ROE and the existing RODs.

section.title: Comments in block 18
section.p: If the ROE was issued with comments in block 18 , the officer must determine if the correct RFS is indicated on the ROE. Any required changes to the RFS details must be made in the Resolve Issue section of the ROE RFS Action WI.

section.title: Reviewing existing records of decision (RODs) on file
section.p: If the RFS is contentious and there is an existing ROD, the officer must determine if the information on the ROE contradicts the decision on file. When a ROD is not found or when the information on the ROE contradicts the ROD, the officer indicates that no decision matches the ROE when completing the Resolve Issue section of the ROE RFS Action WI.
